	RegNo,
	StudentCode,
	StudentName,
	FatherName,
	SchoolName,
	ClassCode,
	Class,
	ShortName,
	Section,
	Medium,
	RollNo,
	RowId
FROM
	(SELECT 
		PageID=1,
		Page = 'Bank Copy',
		itemname = service.name,
		users.username,  
		customer=accounts.name, 
		reprintdate = getDate(),
		reprintcount = dbo.ServiceHeader.ReprintingCounter,
		dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,   
		dbo.serviceheader.date,  
		duedate=dbo.serviceheader.duedate,  
		BillMonth = DATENAME(mm,dbo.serviceheader.duedate),
		dbo.serviceheader.headerno, 
		invdiscperc=dbo.serviceheader.discperc,  
		dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,	 
		dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
		dbo.serviceheader.custcode,   
		dbo.serviceheader.remarks,
		dbo.service.servicecode,   
		price = dbo.servicedetail.price, 
		serviceflatdisc = dbo.servicedetail.serviceflatdisc, 
		Qty = dbo.servicedetail.qty,
		discperc = dbo.servicedetail.discperc,
		RegNo = (SELECT Student.Regno FROM Student WHERE  dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode),
		StudentCode = serviceheader.StudentCode,
		StudentName=(SELECT Student.Name FROM Student WHERE  dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode),
		FatherName=(SELECT Student.FName FROM Student WHERE  dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode),
		SchoolName = (SELECT MAX(SC.Name) FROM School SC, Class C, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass AND SC.SchoolCode = C.SchoolCode),
		ClassCode = (SELECT MAX(C.ClassCode) FROM Class C, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass),
		Class = (SELECT MAX(G.Name) FROM Grade G, Class C, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass AND C.GradeCode = G.GradeCode),
		ShortName = (SELECT MAX(C.ShortName) FROM Grade G, Class C, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass AND C.GradeCode = G.GradeCode),
		Section = (SELECT MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(C.Name, CHARINDEX(',', C.Name, 1)+1, CHARINDEX(',', SUBSTRING(C.Name, CHARINDEX(',', C.Name, 1)-1, LEN(C.Name)),1))))) FROM Class C, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass),
		Medium = (SELECT MAX(CM.Name) FROM Class C, ClassMedium CM, Student WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND C.ClassCode = Student.CurrentClass AND C.ClassMediumCode = CM.ClassMediumCode),
		RollNo = (SELECT MAX(SC.RollNo) FROM Class C, StudentClass SC, Student 
			WHERE dbo.serviceheader.studentcode = student.studentcode AND Student.Studentcode = SC.StudentCode AND 
				Student.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
				C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode),
		RowId=servicedetail.srvrowid
	FROM 
		dbo.serviceheader,   
		dbo.servicedetail,  
		service, 
		customer, 
		accounts,
		users
	WHERE 
		( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode BETWEEN :ra_SInvCode AND :ra_LInvCode) AND
		( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) AND 
		( dbo.serviceheader.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
		( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
		( dbo.serviceheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
		( servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode ) 
	UNION ALL

		RollNo = (SELECT MAX(SC.RollNo) FROM Class C, StudentClass SC, Student
